risks.risk: Garbage-in estimates: three-point ranges are guessed or anchored, so precise-looking outputs rest on weak inputs
risks.mitigation: Ship estimate-quality checks (B12), document how to elicit ranges, prefer ranges calibrated on actuals

risks.risk: Merge bias misunderstood: stakeholders read P50 later than the CPM date as a modelling error
risks.mitigation: Report shows the merge-bias gap explicitly and explains why converging paths push the mean out

risks.risk: Stakeholder anchoring on the deterministic date instead of the P80 commitment
risks.mitigation: Lead the report with the probability of the deterministic date and the P80 commit date

risks.risk: Correlation misspecified: one global rho over- or understates spread
risks.mitigation: Report rho=0 vs configured rho side by side; per-group correlation on the backlog

risks.risk: False precision: 10,000 iterations read as certainty
risks.mitigation: Convergence test in CI; dates reported to the whole working day

risks.risk: Calendar errors (holidays, weekends) shift finish dates
risks.mitigation: Working-day calendar unit tests; holidays explicit in config

risks.risk: MS Project XML import grows in scope (resources, constraints, calendars)
risks.mitigation: Limit M7 to tasks, durations, links and lags; defer resources
